meta.name: ChefFlow asset registry
meta.source: Generated by design-system/registry/build-asset-registry.mjs from public/ plus curated metadata in that file.
meta.howToSearch: node design-system/registry/find.mjs <query> - searches assets, components, patterns and features.
meta.rule: Before adding an asset, search this registry. Reuse before extending, extend before adding. A new asset must be registered here with a role, provenance, licence and usage rule in the same change.

iconSets.rule: Import icons from '@/components/ui/icons'. Never from 'lucide-react'. Never an emoji as an icon.
Legacy. Both icon libraries currently ship to the client. Migrate remaining imports to components/ui/icons and drop the dependency.

fonts.notes: No webfont is loaded for the interface family. This is deliberate.

fonts.family: Caveat, Permanent Marker, Patrick Hand, Indie Flower, Rock Salt, Shadows Into Light Two
fonts.notes: The culinary board is a deliberate handwritten-corkboard surface. Must never leak into a shared component. The raw link tag is render-blocking and unpinned; move it behind next/font/google scoped to that route.
public/fonts/ does not exist, so every render silently falls back to fetching hashed TTFs from fonts.gstatic.com. Fails outright with no egress.

findings.note: Findings are reported, never auto-resolved. Nothing in this script deletes or prunes an owner asset.

provenanceRisks.what: scripts/fetch-directory-photos.mjs and scripts/pi-directory-images/scraper.mjs download og:image / json-ld / hero images from third-party business websites and store them (scripts/pi-directory-images/directory-images.db, ~41 MB).
provenanceRisks.why: The recorded "source" field is a fetch method, not a licence. There is no robots or terms check and no attribution surfaced in the UI.
provenanceRisks.action: Out of design-system scope to resolve. Recorded here so it is not lost. Needs an owner decision on licence capture or attribution before these images are shown publicly.

provenanceRisks.what: The repository contains no LICENSE, NOTICE, ATTRIBUTION or CREDITS file, and no per-asset sidecars.
provenanceRisks.action: Every asset added from now on records licence and provenance in this registry.

provenanceRisks.what: public/images/hero-bg.jpg has no recorded source and EXIF consistent with a stock download.
provenanceRisks.action: Establish the licence or replace with an owned photograph.
